description: One widget in full, plus `issues` — what is still missing before it could go live. Includes its questions, quiz questions and options, quiz tiers and calculator inputs. Which of those are meaningful depends on the kind: questions for lead-magnet and survey, quiz fields for quiz, calculator inputs for calculator, none for popup and announcement-bar. `placement` says where it shows on a site: popups and bars run on every page, every other kind only where a page embeds it — going live alone does not place it on any page.
